title: Nokium
description: Adds Many Nokia Bassed Items And Blocks To Minecraft
body:
### This Mod Adds Nokia Items To Minecraft Like:
This Mod Adds Many New Blocks And Items To The Game Like The Indestructable Nokia Armour And Tools, Its Harder To Find But Stronger Than Netherite 

# [Contact Me](https://sbsx.odoo.com/m/contact)

# Added
- Added 3 Recipes And A Creative Inventory Tab With ALL The Items For This Mod In.
- Nokia Item
- Nokia Tools (Pick, Axe, Shovel, Sword, Hoe)
- Nokia Armour (Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings, Boots)
- Nokia Ore
- Nokia Block
- Nokia Dimension
- Recipes 
- Advancements
